localizedFaqs.question: How should two-way and three-way fittings be selected?
localizedFaqs.answer: A two-way fitting connects two fluidic paths, while a three-way fitting splits one path into two or combines two paths into one. Select the configuration according to the fluidic architecture.

localizedFaqs.question: Is the nominal passage size the same as the thread size?
localizedFaqs.answer: The nominal passage size describes the internal flow path, while the thread specification identifies the interface standard. They are different parameters.

localizedFaqs.question: Can different thread standards be adapted to one another?
localizedFaqs.answer: Use the interface combination of the specific listed model as the reference. For unlisted combinations, submit a custom request.

localizedFaqs.question: How should PP, PA, and stainless-steel material s be selected?
localizedFaqs.answer: Select the material based on fluid compatibility, pressure, temperature, and mechanical strength.

localizedFaqs.question: Can 2D drawings and 3D models be provided?
localizedFaqs.answer: Available resources are shown on the product detail page. For models without uploaded files, add a drawing request or include the documentation requirement in the product-list notes.

localizedFaqs.question: How should the tubing connection size be confirmed?
localizedFaqs.answer: Match the connection size to the tubing ID, and also verify the tubing material, hardness, and actual fit during assembly.

localizedFaqs.question: How should different fitting materials be selected?
localizedFaqs.answer: Select PP, PA, PVDF, or another material based on fluid compatibility, temperature, mechanical strength, and cleanliness requirements.

localizedFaqs.question: Can the fitting color be customized?
localizedFaqs.answer: Standard colors follow the currently available models. Specify any other color requirement when submitting the product list.

localizedFaqs.question: What is the difference between a locking-ring Luer fitting and an integral Luer fitting?
localizedFaqs.answer: A locking-ring design suits connections that require threaded retention, while an integral design is more compact. Select between them based on the available assembly space and connection method.

localizedFaqs.question: How should the tubing connection size be confirmed?
localizedFaqs.answer: Match the connection size to the tubing ID, and also verify the tubing material, hardness, and actual fit during assembly.

localizedFaqs.question: How should different fitting materials be selected?
localizedFaqs.answer: Select PP, PA, PVDF, or another material based on fluid compatibility, temperature, mechanical strength, and cleanliness requirements.

localizedFaqs.question: Can the fitting color be customized?
localizedFaqs.answer: Standard colors follow the currently available models. Specify any other color requirement when submitting the product list.

localizedFaqs.question: How should the tubing connection size be confirmed?
localizedFaqs.answer: Match the connection size to the tubing ID, and also verify the tubing material, hardness, and actual fit during assembly.

localizedFaqs.question: How should different fitting materials be selected?
localizedFaqs.answer: Select PP, PA, PVDF, or another material based on fluid compatibility, temperature, mechanical strength, and cleanliness requirements.

localizedFaqs.question: Can the fitting color be customized?
localizedFaqs.answer: Standard colors follow the currently available models. Specify any other color requirement when submitting the product list.

localizedFaqs.question: What is the difference between a locking-ring Luer fitting and an integral Luer fitting?
localizedFaqs.answer: A locking-ring design suits connections that require threaded retention, while an integral design is more compact. Select between them based on the available assembly space and connection method.

localizedFaqs.question: How should the tubing connection size be confirmed?
localizedFaqs.answer: Match the connection size to the tubing ID, and also verify the tubing material, hardness, and actual fit during assembly.

localizedFaqs.question: How should different fitting materials be selected?
localizedFaqs.answer: Select PP, PA, PVDF, or another material based on fluid compatibility, temperature, mechanical strength, and cleanliness requirements.

localizedFaqs.question: Can the fitting color be customized?
localizedFaqs.answer: Standard colors follow the currently available models. Specify any other color requirement when submitting the product list.

issues.sourceDescription: SA-U32-24F-PP-N是一款直通螺纹密封螺纹转倒刺接头，适配10-32 UNF螺纹与2.4 mm内径软管，用于设备螺纹接口与软管液路之间的转接。采用PP材质，密封方式为螺纹密封，颜色为本色。选型时应结合螺纹标准、软管材质与硬度、介质兼容性及装配空间确认匹配性。
issues.localizedDescription: SA-U32-24F-PP-N is a straight thread-sealed thread-to-barb fitting for 10-32 UNF threads and tubing with an ID of 2.4 mm. It is used for transitions between equipment threaded ports and tubing fluidic lines. It uses PP; sealing is provided by thread sealing, and the color is natural. For selection, confirm compatibility based on thread standard, tubing material and hardness, fluid compatibility and assembly space.
localizedApplications: fluidic transitions inside instruments
connections between pump/valve threaded ports and tubing
fluidic paths in IVD and analytical instruments
fluidic paths in laboratory automation equipment

localizedFaqs.question: What thread and tubing specifications are compatible with SA-U32-24F-PP-N?
localizedFaqs.answer: This model accepts 10-32 UNF threads and connects to tubing with an ID of 2.4 mm.

localizedFaqs.question: Does the barb size correspond to the tubing ID or OD?
localizedFaqs.answer: 2.4 mm refers to the compatible tubing ID on this page. During assembly, also confirm tubing material, wall thickness, and hardness.

localizedFaqs.question: What is the difference between thread sealing and bottom-face sealing?
localizedFaqs.answer: Thread sealing relies on the threaded connection area; bottom-face sealing uses an end-face sealing structure. For selection, match the equipment interface structure.

localizedFaqs.question: Is PP compatible with the target fluid?
localizedFaqs.answer: Confirm PP chemical compatibility based on the actual fluid, temperature, pressure, and cleaning requirements.

localizedFaqs.question: Can I view a 2D dimensional drawing?
localizedFaqs.answer: A public 2D drawing is not currently matched to this record. Contact an engineer through the request form to confirm availability.

issues.sourceDescription: SB-M6-24-PP-N是一款直通底面密封螺纹转倒刺接头，适配M6×1螺纹与2.4 mm内径软管，用于设备螺纹接口与软管液路之间的转接。采用PP材质，密封方式为底面密封，颜色为本色。选型时应结合螺纹标准、软管材质与硬度、介质兼容性及装配空间确认匹配性。
issues.localizedDescription: SB-M6-24-PP-N is a straight bottom-sealed thread-to-barb fitting for M6×1 threads and tubing with an ID of 2.4 mm. It is used for transitions between equipment threaded ports and tubing fluidic lines. It uses PP; sealing is provided by bottom-face sealing, and the color is natural. For selection, confirm compatibility based on thread standard, tubing material and hardness, fluid compatibility and assembly space.

It is used for transitions between equipment threaded ports and tubing fluidic lines. It uses PA; sealing is provided by bottom-face sealing, and the color is white. For selection, confirm compatibility based on thread standard, tubing material and hardness, fluid compatibility and assembly space.
localizedApplications: fluidic transitions inside instruments
connections between pump/valve threaded ports and tubing
fluidic paths in IVD and analytical instruments
fluidic paths in laboratory automation equipment

localizedFaqs.question: What thread and tubing specifications are compatible with SB-M5-40D-PA-W?
localizedFaqs.answer: This model accepts M5×0.8 threads and connects to tubing with an ID of 4.0 mm.

localizedFaqs.question: Does the barb size correspond to the tubing ID or OD?
localizedFaqs.answer: 4.0 mm refers to the compatible tubing ID on this page. During assembly, also confirm tubing material, wall thickness, and hardness.

localizedFaqs.question: What is the difference between thread sealing and bottom-face sealing?
localizedFaqs.answer: Thread sealing relies on the threaded connection area; bottom-face sealing uses an end-face sealing structure. For selection, match the equipment interface structure.

localizedFaqs.question: Is PA compatible with the target fluid?
localizedFaqs.answer: Confirm PA chemical compatibility based on the actual fluid, temperature, pressure, and cleaning requirements.

localizedFaqs.answer: A public 2D drawing is not currently matched to this record. Contact an engineer through the request form to confirm availability.

It is used for transitions between equipment threaded ports and tubing fluidic lines. It uses PP; sealing is provided by female-thread-to-barb connection, and the color is natural. For selection, confirm compatibility based on thread standard, tubing material and hardness, fluid compatibility and assembly space.
localizedApplications: fluidic transitions inside instruments
connections between pump/valve threaded ports and tubing
fluidic paths in IVD and analytical instruments
fluidic paths in laboratory automation equipment

localizedFaqs.question: What thread and tubing specifications are compatible with SC-M6-16-PP-N?
localizedFaqs.answer: This model accepts M6×1 threads and connects to tubing with an ID of 1.6 mm.

localizedFaqs.question: Does the barb size correspond to the tubing ID or OD?
localizedFaqs.answer: 1.6 mm refers to the compatible tubing ID on this page. During assembly, also confirm tubing material, wall thickness, and hardness.

localizedFaqs.question: What is the difference between thread sealing and bottom-face sealing?
localizedFaqs.answer: Thread sealing relies on the threaded connection area; bottom-face sealing uses an end-face sealing structure. For selection, match the equipment interface structure.

localizedFaqs.question: Is PP compatible with the target fluid?
localizedFaqs.answer: Confirm PP chemical compatibility based on the actual fluid, temperature, pressure, and cleaning requirements.

localizedFaqs.question: Can I view a 2D dimensional drawing?
localizedFaqs.answer: A public 2D drawing is not currently matched to this record. Contact an engineer through the request form to confirm availability.
